notes.title: Play Rift Saviours' Demo as part of PixElated Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739217/64418363f95650feca4d737797822c93d07ebc64.png[/img]

We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that Rift Saviours joins PixElated Festival next week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/

notes.title: New demo version coming.
notes.notes:
Hey!
A new version for the playable demo is around the corner, since this new update is going to bring new 
and big changes we don't feel like the current version is representative of the game vision anymore. So we are making it unavailable until the update drops!
Stay tuned, see u in the next patch notes.

notes.title: New demo update is out! Steam Endless Replayability Fest edition!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey! The next update for the demo is now LIVE!.[/h2]
[h3]
[b]This upgrades contains:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Combat improvements (specially on the feedback when attacking with the katana, new visual fxs and sfxs, etc)
[*] Artwork redesign, there are some resources that will have a brand new aspect

[*] New progression system, the shop.
[*]        by killing enemies you now get a new kind of coin that will be necessary to buy the items from 
            the shop.
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739217/d9f2b50ae05b965e36f5079c2864955947a28832.png[/img]

[*] How many items there are?
[*] That answer is, it depends! It can range from 120k to 300k max. We have been working on a system that can procedurally generate items for every stat in the upgrade, is our most playtested feature, we hope you enjoy it as much as we do!.

[*] New HUD - Now you can see the controls/hotkeys on the UI in a much more clear way.
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739217/4f42d61f6da27d75a568e25020ce12a233e9f912.png[/img]

[*] New Character! Her name is Hass, she wields the greatsword Diana
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739217/cce5315392a1c9684b3e7ce264bb0f72ada6b066.png[/img]

[*] Main Hub! - Basically a new starting area where you would be able to craft and buy items with the resources of the previous run!
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739217/f97d2b852a8696b858204285d17a173e5d8677fb.png[/img]

[/list]

Alongside this update. From now on we have taken the challenge of releasing a new demo update every two weeks, gathering player feedback along the way.
This process will continue until the Early Access Release!
See you in the next patch notes
